executiveSummary: The reporting period features multiple high-urgency incidents with direct public-safety, democratic, and financial impacts. Notably, U.S. prosecutors charged three foreign nationals in a large-scale executive-impersonation scheme that allegedly used AI-cloned voices and images of CEOs and attorneys to facilitate transfers totaling more than $129 million across multiple sectors and jurisdictions. View Article Election-related synthetic media remains a central risk vector in the United States, with an FBI-CISA public advisory warning of convincing deepfake audio and video paired with phishing/smishing against election and campaign stakeholders, as well as reporting on likely foreign-linked, AI-assisted disinformation videos targeting Senate races in the final stretch before voting. Security Advisory View Article Public-safety and information-integrity risks were underscored by a hack of a widely used Ukrainian alert app that pushed fake radiation and attack warnings using familiar audio cues, and by cloned-law-enforcement voice scams targeting residents in Florida. View Article View Article On the defensive front, provenance and labeling efforts continue to expand, though challenges persist. Federal guidance encourages verification of watermarking and content credentials during election operations, while research highlights potential evasion of commercial speech watermarks and very low real-world C2PA coverage in tested images-both factors that complicate detection workflows. Security Advisory Supporting Report Supporting Report Overall, the threat environment appears to be worsening due to concurrent election interference activity, public-safety deception, and high-value corporate fraud, alongside indications that certain authenticity controls may be evaded or lack widespread adoption. Election operations: Implement step-up verification for urgent or high-impact requests; pre-register known-good comms channels; require dual approval for changes to polling operations. (Analyst Recommendation)

Corporate finance: Enforce out-of-band callbacks to independently known numbers for all wire/ACH approvals; disable voice-only authorizations; use transaction velocity and counterpart risk scoring. (Analyst Recommendation)

Newsrooms: Require signed provenance (C2PA) where feasible; verify contributor identities with escrowed IDs; compare incoming "broadcast" clips against internal air-check logs. (Analyst Recommendation)
Public-safety comms: Maintain redundant alerting channels; pre-script public advisories for alert spoof scenarios; monitor for unauthorized alert payload changes. (Analyst Recommendation)

Security teams: Integrate provenance checks into media intake; deploy anomaly detection for voice traffic; maintain a playbook for deepfake incident triage and evidence preservation. (Analyst Recommendation)
